Name: Directional Roughness
Description: Adds band-limited fractal Perlin detail along the chosen angle, scaled by local uphill slope.

Sections.Name: Direction
Sections.Label: Direction
Sections.Description: Angle sets the horizontal direction; feather softens the transition as the terrain turns away from the uphill direction.

Params.Name: Angle
Params.Label: Angle
Params.Description: Sets the horizontal detail direction; strength is masked by uphill slope alignment.

Params.Name: Feather
Params.Label: Feather
Params.Description: Softens the fade where the uphill slope turns away from the selected direction.

Sections.Name: Detail
Sections.Label: Fine detail
Sections.Description: Adds layered Perlin noise. Each octave doubles frequency and halves amplitude; undersampled layers fade out.

Params.Name: Frequency
Params.Label: Detail frequency
Params.Description: Controls the base feature size in terrain space. Higher map resolutions retain finer octave layers without changing the larger noise features.

Params.Name: Octaves
Params.Label: Fine layers
Params.Description: Adds progressively finer detail layers. Layers too small for the map resolution are automatically faded out.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Label: Detail strength
Params.Description: Maximum amplitude as a fraction of terrain height range; displacement is capped at 1.25 times local relief at the base frequency.
